patchNotes: Fixed hats and busts hiding custom hair, including after changing clothing. No new toggle is required. Fixed physics-hair equip timeouts by detecting native equip completion. Hair materials now apply after equipping and include hidden meshes; changing selections cancels stale material requests. Existing Hair visibility and Restore Game Outfit controls are preserved. The custom-hair fix was confirmed working in game. Automatic emote downloads remain included; experimental TV and multiplayer-media limitations are unchanged.
